answers.q: How is success measured in this role in the first six months?
answers.a: In an HR Generalist role, early success would typically mean handling employee queries reliably, supporting hiring and onboarding processes, maintaining accurate people records, and building trust with managers and employees. The recruiter can share the specific measures used here. What else would you like to know?

answers.q: What does a typical week look like?
answers.a: A typical week in an HR Generalist role can include responding to employee queries, supporting hiring and onboarding, updating people records, and working with managers on day-to-day people matters. The recruiter can share the team’s specific priorities and schedule. What else would you like to know?
